facts: Sydney Park is the largest park in the dataset at 39.0 ha.
23% of mapped City of Sydney parks (95 of 418) have a playground.
51 designated off-leash dog areas are mapped across the network.
The dataset includes 3,127 public toilets from the National Public Toilet Map.
273 drinking fountains are mapped from City of Sydney open data.
48,999 street trees are mapped across the City of Sydney extract.
1,795 National Parks facilities are mapped — the most common is picnic table (568).
26,198 public transport stops (bus, rail, ferry, metro, light rail) can be overlaid on the map.
Council boundaries cover 12,396 km² across 35 Greater Sydney councils.
Average tree canopy across the 33 measured councils is 22.2%.
